correctness.rationale: Reconstructed dimension 2m-2 and free-sum-of-two-(m-1)-simplices facet census m^2. Cycle-incidence Gram determinant supplies m^4(ab)^(2m-2), each omit-one-from-each-matching facet has wedge squared (ab)^(2m-2)(E_t/a^2+O_t/b^2); converting the cone volume to facet height gives the stated Euclidean area, with E_t=m t(m-t), O_t=m(t+1)(m-t-1). Paired identity E_(m-1-t)=O_t and vector triangle inequality yield the cosh(log(a/b)/2) sharp factor, strict when m>=3 and a!=b. Uniform normalized mixture lambda in [0,1] and |sqrt(x)-sqrt(y)|<=sqrt(|x-y|) give an O(m^-1/2) uniform mesh error; its positive integral pi/8 proves the weak beta limit and surface normalization even for unbounded anisotropy. Independently reconstructed 58 exact rational facet Gram determinants for m=2..4 and (a,b)=(1,1),(2,3), also base wedge determinants. Finite tests are supplemental, not the general proof.

value.rationale: Motivated Euclidean isoperimetric deformation of a natural graphic root/edge polytope, with a sharp all-parameter minimizer and an unusually robust area-weighted facet-limit distribution despite unbounded anisotropy. The full-scale uniformity and rigidity are genuine geometric information beyond the previously tabulated unweighted facet distances.

final_claim: For all m>=2 and a,b>0, exact individual facet areas and total surface/volume of the two-color-scaled even-cycle edge polytope; optimal bound S(a,b)>=((a+b)/(2sqrt(ab)))S(sqrt(ab),sqrt(ab)), equality all scales for m=2 and only balanced scales for m>=3; uniform-aspect-ratio Beta(3/2,3/2) area-weighted offset law.
limitations: Unbounded-ratio weak law is not pointwise density convergence; metric is intrinsic inherited Euclidean metric.
